Ziffr to Planner

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address, the Webhook's id and secret, and the id of the plan and of the bucket new tasks go into (Microsoft Graph: GET /me/planner/plans, GET /planner/plans/{id}/buckets).
2. Add a credential "OAuth2 API" for Microsoft Graph (scope Tasks.ReadWrite) to the HTTP Request nodes.
3. Replace the Webhook path with a long random string, activate the workflow and put its production URL into the Webhook in Ziffr (events: action.created, action.updated, action.done).

Self-hosted n8n: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto. Details: docs/automations/planner.md
